title: BECE Business Studies: Office Practice - Business Studies - Right Attitude to Work
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The habit of arriving at the workplace or for an official assignment exactly at the agreed or official time is referred to as
questions.explain: **Punctuality** specifically means being on time and arriving promptly for resumption or meetings.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An employee who consistently attends work on every required working day without unauthorized absences demonstrates
questions.explain: **Regularity** refers to consistent, unbroken attendance at work without playing truant.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A staff member who comes to work every single day but always arrives an hour after the official resumption time exhibits
questions.explain: Because the staff does not miss a day, they have **regularity**. However, arriving late every day means they lack **punctuality**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an attribute of punctuality and regularity?
questions.explain: Promptness, consistency, and reliability are positive attributes associated with the right attitude to work. **Truancy** (staying away from work without good reason) is the exact opposite of regularity.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The strong commitment and willingness of a worker to dedicate time, energy, and loyalty to successfully complete assigned official tasks is known as
questions.explain: **Devotion to duty** implies deep commitment, dedication, and putting the organization's goals first in the execution of one's assigned tasks.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When workers exhibit the right attitude to work through devotion and regularity, the most likely direct effect on the organization is
questions.explain: Punctual and devoted workers are more efficient and achieve targets faster, leading to **an increase in productivity** for the organization.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The negative effects of continuous lateness, absenteeism, and lack of devotion to duty in an office include all the following EXCEPT
questions.explain: Lateness and absenteeism lead to low productivity and lost revenue. They definitely would NOT lead to **rapid business expansion**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An employee who stays back after closing hours to ensure an urgent and critical task is successfully completed before a deadline is primarily showing
questions.explain: Going the extra mile to finish an important task even if it requires extra personal time is a strong sign of **devotion to duty**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A positive attitude to work by citizens generally affects the overall development of a country by
options: boosting economic growth and national wealth
questions.explain: On a macro level, when individuals display devotion, regularity, and punctuality across various businesses, it maximizes total output, leading to **economic growth and national wealth**.
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following describes the relationship between a positive attitude to work and productivity?
options: A positive attitude drastically lowers productivity.
A positive attitude has no visible effect on productivity.
A positive attitude is directly linked to higher productivity.
Productivity relies entirely on machines, ignoring workers' attitudes.
questions.explain: There is a direct correlation: employees with a good work ethic (punctual, regular, devoted) work more effectively, meaning **a positive attitude is directly linked to higher productivity**.
questions.subject: Business Studies
